inputs.text: Stalin’s DMK is leaning on a familiar politics of dependency: doubling women’s monthly aid to Rs 2,000, offering Rs 8,000 household coupons and free motor pumpsets for farmers. That may earn applause now, but it treats citizens as recipients of government favors rather than families and workers who deserve the chance to stand on their own. Tamil Nadu needs lasting jobs, investment and AI development, alongside sensible support for fishermen—not an ever-expanding catalogue of giveaways that puts political loyalty ahead of responsibility and a stronger economy.
